issues: React DevTools hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> (ClassificationCheck.jsx:903, CarePlanReviewer.jsx:559). This is a preview-only dev-tool <select> instrumentation wrapper (data-ve-dynamic span) — visible only in dev bundles and does not affect functionality. Consider stripping x-source/data-ve-dynamic wrappers from <option> descendants in the ve-plugin so production DOM stays clean.
